messages.content: What is the best month to visit Hawaii?

function.name: get_average_monthly_temperature
function.description: Retrieve the average monthly temperature of a location. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The location that you want to get the average monthly temperature for.

month.description: Month for which the average temperature needs to be fetched.

message.content:
The “sweet spot” for visiting Hawaii is typically late spring through early fall—specifically **April, May, September, and October**.  

| Month | Why it’s great |
|-------|----------------|
| **April** | Warm, sunny weather (average highs ~81 °F / 27 °C) but still before the peak summer crowds. |
| **May** | Similar warmth, plus the start of the whale‑watching season and fewer tourists than July‑August. |
| **September** | Still hot and sunny (highs ~84 °F / 29 °C), but the summer rush has thinned out and prices drop. |
| **October** | Mild temperatures (highs ~82 °F / 28 °C), excellent surf conditions, and the best deals on accommodations. |

### Quick weather snapshot (average highs)

| Month | Avg. High (°F) | Avg. High (°C) |
|-------|----------------|----------------|
| April | 81 | 27 |
| May | 83 | 28 |
| September | 84 | 29 |
| October | 82 | 28 |

These months combine pleasant temperatures, lower crowds, and better rates on flights and hotels. If you’re looking for the absolute best value and still want great weather, **late September to early October** is often the sweet spot.
